items.title: Jensen Huang reclaims throne at Nvidia: Here's the bottom line for investors
items.summary:
Nvidia's (NVDA) stock continued to waver in Wednesday's trading session, seemingly after the fanfare around CEO Jensen Huang's return had died down.

Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares his perspective on Huang's reinstatement and what it reflects in the chipmaker's stock moves.

items.title: Jensen Huang's return, neocloud risk, and a holiday retail rally
items.summary: In this special edition of Sozzi Unleashed: At The Close, Brian Sozzi warns that investors can be right about a tech revolution and still lose a fortune, lays out three reasons Nvidia may deserve another look after Jensen Huang's return, and explains why the debt-fueled neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius still make him nervous. Former federal prosecutor Gil Soffer, head of corporate investigations at Katten, joins to discuss how Nvidia's board probe proceeds with Huang back in charge and whether he could be fired again. Brian also connects the dots on the AI build-out and inflation with a clip from Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee, and makes the case for a strong holiday season for retailers with comments from Walmart CFO John David Rainey and Gap CEO Richard Dickson.

items.title: Nvidia is cheap on paper, so why won't the market buy it?
items.summary: Market Hang tackles the top stories of the day. Including Nvidia giving back about half of its Jensen Huang rally and why a stock growing sales 60% to 70% can trade at 10 times earnings, whether the Alice Wong affair was a "hit job," and what next week's Senate testimony means for the stock.

items.title: Why Nvidia's 'Jensen put' failed to stop the AI trade meltdown
items.summary: Jensen Huang's return as CEO on Monday may have temporarily stabilized the AI trade, but it did little to fix the broader financial pressures weighing on markets.

items.title: China added nearly 10 times more power capacity than the US in 2025 as the AI race heats up
items.summary: While the US fights to maintain an edge in computing advancement, China has pulled far ahead in power capacity generation.

items.title: MU, SNDK, SKHY Jump As Nvidia Tests Kioxia Memory Fix — Analyst Presses Memory Giants For ‘Massive’ Buybacks
items.summary: Nvidia and Kioxia tested 144 flash drives in one AI rack. Kioxia estimates the setup could support a database of up to 2 trillion vectors.

items.title: Nvidia stops shipping AI servers to 4 Southeast Asian countries- FT
items.summary: Investing.com-- Nvidia has told its manufacturing partners to halt server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries amid tighter U.S. export controls, the Financial Times reported on Thursday.

items.title: Kioxia jumps 14% after Nvidia collaboration as chip stocks rebound
items.summary: Investing.com -- Kioxia Holdings shares surged on Thursday, extending a sharp rebound in Japanese semiconductor stocks after the memory chipmaker announced a collaboration with Nvidia to expand effective GPU memory capacity using its solid-state drives.
